label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 47
title: MVP: License tiers + feature-group entitlements (categorize all modules into logical groups)
body:
Categorize ALL features/modules into logical groups (G1 Core Orchestration & Portfolio; G2 Discovery & Design; G3 Quality & Compliance; G4 Build/Deploy/Ops; G5 Intake & Work Management; G6 Collaboration & Tenancy; G7 Intelligence (chat/learning/model rec/BYOT); G8 Content & Media; G9 Platform Ops & Licensing (operator-only); G10 Extensibility & API) and map them to license tiers; show what each tier entitles; enforce in the UI (locked/unlocked with upgrade prompts). Backend entitlement source of truth (BI-0059).

TIER CONCURRENCY (owner): each TIER also defines how many projects the customer may CREATE and RUN at the same time (concurrency + total), enforced by the capacity governor (config/capacity.json) parameterized by tier/tenant/user. Global limits stay the hard ceiling; the tier quota is the effective limit.
